title: M5Stack emulator repository tidy: branch, worktree, tag and stash inventory

source.issue: none: direct user request to tidy the repository branches

execution.environment: macOS arm64; git and GitHub CLI; no guest runtime, browser or physical hardware

checks.name: local_merged_branch_cleanup
checks.values: 70 merged branches deleted with git branch -d; 89 branches were merged into main before cleanup

checks.name: local_obsolete_unmerged_cleanup
checks.values: 9 branches deleted with -D after git cherry equivalence, superseding commit (786a4e4d), or merged PR #80/#166 evidence

checks.name: remote_branch_cleanup
checks.values: 25 non-main remote branches deleted; git ls-remote --heads origin shows only main

checks.name: worktree_prune
checks.values: 4 stale gitdir records pruned; 2 old clean detached worktrees under the temp directory removed; 31 -> 25 worktree entries

checks.name: attic_archive
checks.values: attic/local-history (21 commits) and attic/units26-fix2 (1 commit) retained as local archival refs

checks.name: tags_and_stash
checks.values: 12 tags kept; 1 WIP stash retained without destructive handling

checks.name: external_worktree_branch_cleanup
checks.reason: 23 remaining local branches are checked out in external codex/sibling workspaces; retiring those workspaces is out of scope for this pass.

checks.name: git_gc_and_stash_drop
checks.reason: Object packages are shared by many worktrees and mostly reachable from main; WIP stash kept for human review.

notes: No tracked file, service port (8787/8792) or working-tree content was modified.
Two stale unbound QOM debug sockets from 2026-10-21 were removed; config-temp and config.log were preserved.
The repository main history retains every merged commit removed at ref level; no commit content was discarded.
